title: Dick Tracy
about: A square-jawed detective takes on Big Boy Caprice's gangsters.
cue: Serve the mains when Big Boy holds court at the Club Ritz.
faces: “Dick, your supper is cold again. I'm not mad, I'm just keeping it on the stove.”
Egg yolk mayo topped with salmon roe, plus prosciutto wrapped asparagus.
Baked choux puffs with gruyère and a pinch of turmeric.
Pork and beef meatballs simmered in San Marzano tomato sauce with basil.
His usual order, between radio calls.
Sweet shortcrust shell, tart lemon filling and torched meringue.
Gin, lime juice and lime cordial shaken until frosty.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing the yellow trench coat and fedora at the tables. Card No. 1990. Showtime: Serve the mains when Big Boy holds court at the Club Ritz.
